**The meaning of the verses**
﴿فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ﴾ ﴿الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ﴾
So severe punishment is for those who pray but are heedless of their prayer, who do not perform it properly and do not offer it on time.

﴿الَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَاءُونَ﴾
Those who make a show of good deeds, to be seen by people.

﴿وَيَمْنَعُونَ الْمَاعُونَ﴾
And they refuse to lend things that do no harm to lend, such as pots and the like. So they neither worshipped their Lord well, nor treated His creation well.

📖 At-Tafsir Al-Muyassar — King Fahd Complex.

**Talk with your child**
1. Why did Sheikha not lend the pot to Ghanem? And would her mother have refused if she had been awake?
2. What did Umm Ghanem send back with the ember? And what did Ghanem mean when he said, "An ember doesn't make our fire any smaller"?
3. Do we have to lend everything to everyone who asks? (That is not required; the verse condemns the one who, out of stinginess, refuses to lend what does no harm to lend, such as a pot or a bucket. And what belongs to the parents is not lent without their permission.)

**This week's exercise**
This week your child chooses one of their things, a book, a toy or some pencils, and lends it to a brother, sister or friend, and asks for it back nicely. And in return they learn to give back what they borrow clean and on time.
